newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam and De Amersfoortse in new venture.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam and De Amersfoortse in new venture.

text.p: Dutch insurers Stad Rotterdam and unlisted De Amersfoortse intend to intensify their cooperation and form a new holding company, both firms said on Friday.
The insurers envisage listing the new company, to be called ASR Verzekeringsgroep N.V., which will include all shares of both Stad Rotterdam and De Amersfoortse.

Stad Rotterdam currently holds a 55 percent stake in De Amersfoortse, while 25 percent of the shares belongs to the Muenchener Ruckversicherungs-Gesellschaft and 20 percent to Nuernberger Beteiligungs-AG.
Talks with both sets of shareholders are underway and further announcements are expected within a few weeks, both insurers said.
